Silver
Hepatitis C
Silver has no known function in the human body, and is not
an essential mineral supplement. Claims of silver “deﬁ ciency” 
in the body are unfounded. Silver builds up in body tissues:
argyria—a bluish gray discoloration of the body, especially 
skin, other organs, deep tissues, nails, and gums. Argyria is 
not treatable or reversible. Other possible problems include
neurologic effects (such as seizures), kidney damage,
stomach distress, headaches, fatigue, and skin irritation. May
